Noah (People Ops): Quick pulse: auditors want a small extra step this year managers must attach a signed owner confirmation for any team uploading controls evidence. Please add a PDF signature to the Confluence row or upload to the evidence bucket with tag `signed_owner_<team>`. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-audit-window :page_with_curl:
Zoe (Security): Is the signature a scanned signature or an OKTA-signed attestation?
Noah (People Ops): Either is fine. Preferred is an OKTA attestation screenshot or Google-signed doc. Scans are accepted but please include a date, manager name, and team.
Hector (Eng): Does this apply to GTM controls-only lane too? Our managers are out next week.
Noah (People Ops): Yes, applies to all lanes. If a manager is OOO, their skip should be recorded as an exception in Confluence and a delegate must sign. We'll accept manager delegations documented in Confluence until the audit team flags it.
Maya (Legal): Reminder: when attaching signed docs, redact any salaries or sensitive employee info. Use the redaction checklist. We'll spot-check signatures for authenticity sampling.
Hector (Eng): Any change to file naming? Last audit we had collisions.
Noah (People Ops): New naming: `evidence_2026.<lane>.<team>.<owner_signed>.<part>` Example: `evidence_2026.A.runtime.ravi_signed.01.pdf`. Keep lowercase and underscores avoided.
Zoe (Security): We'll add a validation step to the manifest template that checks for the signed_owner tag and flags missing signatures. Also pushing a small script to validate filenames and manifest checksum.
Noah (People Ops): evidence-bot will auto-scan uploads and post a confirmation. We'll send a summary each Friday of missing signatures so leads can follow up.
:evidence-bot: Upload scanner: 3 missing signed_owner tags found for Lane B teams. Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-30 09:00 UTC.
Noah (People Ops): Office hours on 2026-04-30 15:00 UTC to walk through the new signed-owner step and manifest validator. Recording + sample docs will be on Confluence. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
